name: KANGWON ENERGY Co., Ltd.
summary: KANGWON ENERGY Co., Ltd. operates primarily within the secondary battery and energy plant industries. The company delivers an extensive range of services across these sectors, encompassing conceptual and detailed thermal design, foundational engineering, procurement, manufacturing, fabrication, on-site installation, and final commissioning. Its offerings include specialized system engineering, PD mixers, various storage vessels, and powder weighing and transfer systems. For the production of cathode materials, KANGWON ENERGY supplies essential equipment such as electric heater dryers, electromagnetic filters, jet mills, roll crushers, and sieving machines. Additionally, the firm is responsible for the design, construction, setup, and activation of significant energy plant components like water tube steam generators, sulfur recovery units, hot oil heaters, waste heat boilers, and heat recovery steam generators. Founded in 1976 and headquartered in Gunsan-si, South Korea, the company was formerly known as KANGWON Co., Ltd. until its rebranding to KANGWON ENERGY Co., Ltd. in October 2021.
